update.description: Transactional publishing and concurrent edit protection

update.SQL: ALTER TABLE tbl_simpleblog_posts ADD COLUMN composition_json LONGTEXT NULL, ADD COLUMN legacy_content_html LONGTEXT NULL, ADD COLUMN published_at DATETIME NULL;
UPDATE tbl_simpleblog_posts SET published_at=datecreated WHERE post_status='posted' AND published_at IS NULL;

update.description: Explicit featured images for publication cards
update.SQL: ALTER TABLE tbl_simpleblog_posts ADD COLUMN featured_image LONGTEXT NULL, ADD COLUMN featured_alt LONGTEXT NULL;

update.description: Optional membership access; existing posts remain public
update.SQL: ALTER TABLE tbl_simpleblog_posts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS required_tier_code VARCHAR(32) NULL;

update.description: Reconcile imported provenance and membership access without replacing content
update.SQL: ALTER TABLE tbl_simpleblog_posts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS author_credit VARCHAR(250) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_key VARCHAR(191) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_url LONGTEXT NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_hash VARCHAR(64) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS import_hash VARCHAR(64) NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS required_tier_code VARCHAR(32) NULL, ADD UNIQUE KEY IF NOT EXISTS simpleblog_source_unique (source_key);
